title: Hormozi: You're Not Hungry, You're Bored.
hook: Real hunger will eat protein. Boredom wants chips.
body:
Alex Hormozi, as usual, is right. Real hunger will eat protein. Boredom wants chips. Most of what you call hunger at night is boredom. If you were actually hungry, a plain chicken breast would sound good.

This is the number one change I made to get abs at 40. I swapped chips, trail mix, and dried fruit for protein snacks like hard boiled eggs and sardines.

So starting tomorrow, keep the protein ready to grab. I buy pre-packaged hard boiled eggs and keep cans of sardines around.

Subscribe and go to SixPackAbs.com for all my newest videos.
